name: etsy-pp-mcp
description: Etsy Open API v3 commands plus a local SQLite store for offline fee reports, ledger reconciliation, listing and GPSR audits, market research, and previewed bulk edits.

etsy_api_key.title: ETSY_API_KEY
etsy_api_key.description: Your Etsy app keystring (the API key). Required. May also be the full keystring:shared_secret.

etsy_shared_secret.title: ETSY_SHARED_SECRET
etsy_shared_secret.description: Your Etsy app shared secret. Required unless ETSY_API_KEY already contains keystring:secret.

etsy_oauth2.title: ETSY_OAUTH2
etsy_oauth2.description: Optional pasted OAuth bearer token. Normally supplied by 'etsy-pp-cli auth login'.

etsy_shop_id.title: ETSY_SHOP_ID
etsy_shop_id.description: Your numeric Etsy shop id. Optional; only needed for shop-scoped data.
